title: Example 149 (B11, contract library): full jitter proved on the contract library's contracts alone, applied on the records of their checks under --max-trust 0
description: New example for step 3d of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md (contracts kept and reused). The Crosscut change of examples 147/148 (Jitter#fullJitterMillis) with no contracts file of the agent's: under --engine native --gaps advised --max-trust 0 the tool's built-in contract library (lib/models/contracts) closes the three gaps (Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros, Random(long), Random.nextInt(int)), each applied on its record in checked.json (proved against java.lang.Integer's bytecode, or tested on the JVM, on JDK 25.0.4.1) without a proof or JVM test in the run, and the property (result in [0, capMillis), IllegalArgumentException for an invalid policy) is proved on every input. The page should name the library's files and say each contract was checked once.
expected: verdict verified, relying on 3 contracts for gaps of the tool's own checker, 1 proved, 2 tested; each contract in result.search.gaps has file lib/models/contracts/<class>.contracts and recorded 'checked once, on JDK 25.0.4.1 ...'; the label says (1 proved, 2 tested)

resources.notes: checked inline on the patched module: about 0.08 s for the proof, no contract checks; the build and the module's tests take most of the time
